images.caption: USGS seismicity around Mw8.8 Kamchatka earthquake, January 1 2024 through July 30 2025. Earthquakes are projected to the right onto a timeline since July 19, 2025, and also shown on a cross-section below the map. Events between January 1, 2024 and July 19, 2025 are colored pink. Most of these earthquakes occurred as aftershocks following the M7.1 earthquake in August 2024. After July 19, the events are colored by time (blue-green-yellow-orange-red). These include the M7.4 earthquake on July 20, and its immediate foreshocks and aftershocks. The M8.8 mainshock and its aftershocks are gray. Black line with teeth shows subduction trench. The band of earthquakes at 10 km depth in the cross-section are an artifact (assigned a default depth).
